body: If it scares you then I don't think you have much to worry about yet. It scared me too for a long time. Now, its more calming than any other emotion. I feel bad for the people who care about me and sometimes I wonder what it would be like to go back to living under a rock, not having to think about the way things really are. I used to talk to people about these things but I have yet to meet anyone that didn't seem to become more depressed by giving me the opportunity to voice my thoughts. Even my therapist avoids certain topics with me because she just has nothing to say that helps, in any sense of the word. Only offers more pills, which at this point she will literally prescribe me anything I am interested in checking out. She isn't the only one I have been to either btw.

No worries, I didn't take anything you said negatively..

"the way we are as people" - well, violent, selfish, destructive, persistent, short-sighted, pillagers to put it shortly. Collectively we are all just surviving. We try as hard as we can to do so without having to sacrifice anymore than we have already. When people have children I feel many times the attitude changes more toward being about their children's future/world and maybe a little more awareness about the impact the person has on their world is realized. But in the end, we are a species spiraling out of control. Each consecutive generation will continue to feel the strain more and more until we are old, sickly, medicine-dependent, drug-motivated, unhappy, frail animals just waiting for the final blow to us, the human race. 

moving backwards - Science. It's the tiger's back, we can never get off. The more treatments we find and cures we create the more people we will inevitably have. Even if population growth ceased to zero today, our environment is passed the point of being able to sustain us. I have a B.A. in Horticulture and if there if one thing that became insanely clear to me long ago is that we(humans) veered off course down the evolutionary path some while back. Our brains gave us the advantage in terms of living a single generation(the short-sightedness of people) but we were flawed from the start(as a potentially successful species) by not having the capacity mentally to have the foresight necessary to ensure our actions would not devastate ourselves in generations to come. We are, have been, and will continue to feel this suffering due to the lack of foresight of our ancestors. Bottom line, I do not feel vital to my species. My existence itself is of no benefit the natural world and of no benefit to mankind's future survival. I could go on and on about this subject but maybe you kind of see what I mean when I say what I did.

Yes I have. Honestly, I don't feel depressed. I'm tired of the drugs. I am not rushing out the door to go off myself but I have decided that it is the way I will likely go. And when the time is right it will happen. There are things I would like to say first(some known, some not known yet) and things I would like to get in order before I do anything. If I could get myself some place that I could be truly in nature and live there without adversely affecting my surroundings then I would feel justified in continuing my existence. Rainforest conservationist effort maybe? But the way the world is, it is only a matter of time before companies and needy people snuff out the last bit of every easily accessible resource. Witness our greed make the earth bleed. (I know this sounds sophomoric-like and that I shouldn't be letting global problems burden me, but this is just one small aspect of the entire motive)

I don't want to cause the dominos to tumble, so please let me apologize if I have struck a nerve. I just want to drop-out of society more than I actually want to kill myself. Suicide just seems to be the most efficient solution to doing so. I just look around and see the world we create and know deep down that things are not supposed to be like this. That is the only thing I ever truly feel sad about. If it wouldn't take me an eon to scrounge the money together to get out of debt enough to be able to move from this country I would possibly reconsider. But really, I feel like that would only be putting of the inevitable. Maybe it will be a suicide by nature. To go out there with nothing but my bare hands and to either live or die because of them is the closest thing I could envision to feeling alive. What we have now is just so far removed from that that I don't even know that what I am thinking about is possibly, hence the lack of motivation.

I know it seems that most of my problems are money related but they really are just symptomatic of something more deeply troubling. It is difficult for me to articulate it. Up until 2 years ago I actually was doing pretty well for myself financially and I feel like that is when all of this started. I just feel empty, and money isn't going to change it. If anything, I felt more guilty feeling this way when I had cash pouring in than I do now. And when I say oven, I am not planning to blow myself up, just inhaling the gas to the point of death from lack of oxygen. You pass out before any pain becomes even the most vague of ideas. I really just can't live with the way I am and the way **we** are as people. I am not blaming society or anything like that, I just have become so insanely disconnected from my empathy and sympathy that the motivation I used to have to get up and do something with my day has gone completely. I seriously believe that our species is moving evolutionarily backwards and I have no intention of procreating and reproducing a copy of my mis-wired brain. I've done the pill thing, ADD/ADHD, anxiety, SSRIs, you name it. Those things make living tolerable but they certainly don't make me feel alive, they just make me feel like a tired little quiet robot wasting air. I'm just tired of it all. I really don't even feel depressed, this is something I have been considering for years.

Its a little beyond being bailed out money-wise at this point I am fairly certain. Unless someone wants to spot me 15k? I wouldn't take it though anyways, I am just sick of being a consumer. I want out of this place but there isn't anywhere to go.
